currentPriorities.order: The selected indpack outfit/assistant-role mood variant overrides its normal indpack image; normal indpack overrides the legacy/cache default after alias repair. Horny (arousal>3) precedes rebel (moral<3). Empty-string checks only; missing nonempty paths do not fall through.

Six role-availability gates inspect only legacy role arrays. Four click handlers store legacy array values into assistant.fullimage. New-only role entries cannot open those menu choices.
Nonempty indpack_title wins; otherwise legacy fullimage or existing alias resolver. No physical-file check.
Legacy fullimage presence is outer gate. Nonempty indpack_naked then overrides old preview. New-only naked cannot pass an empty legacy outer gate.
